1.w: And passing by, He saw a man blind from birth.

2.w: And His disciples asked Him, saying, “Rabbi, who sinned, this [man] or his parents, that he should be born blind?”

3.w: Jesus answered, “Neither this [man] sinned, nor his parents; but [it was] so that the works of God should be displayed in him.

4.w: It is necessary for us to work the works of the One having sent Me while it is day; night is coming, when no one is able to work.

5.w: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”

6.w: Having said these things, He spit on the ground and made clay of the spittle, and He applied the clay to his eyes.

7.w: And He said to him, “Go, wash in the pool of Siloam” (which means “Sent”). Therefore he went away and washed and came [back] seeing.

8.w: Therefore the neighbors and those seeing him before, that he was a beggar, were saying, “Is this not the one sitting and begging?”

9.w: Others were saying, “This is [he].” Others were saying, “No, but he is like him.” He was saying, “I am [he].”

10.w: Therefore they were saying to him, “How then were your eyes opened?”

11.w: He answered, “The man called Jesus made clay and anointed my eyes, and He said to me, ‘Go to Siloam and wash.’ Therefore, having gone away and having washed, I received sight.”

12.w: And they said to him, “Where is He?” He says, “I do not know.”

13.w: They bring him who once [was] blind to the Pharisees.

14.w: Now it was a Sabbath—the day on which Jesus made the clay and opened his eyes.

15.w: Again, therefore, the Pharisees also were asking him how he received sight. And he said to them, “He put clay on my eyes, and I washed, and I see.”

16.w: Therefore some of the Pharisees were saying, “This man is not from God, because He does not keep the Sabbath.” But others were saying, “How is a man, a sinner, able to do such signs?” And there was division among them.

17.w: Therefore they say to the blind [man] again, “What do you say about Him, since He opened your eyes?” And he said, “He is a prophet.”

18.w: Therefore the Jews did not believe concerning him that he was blind and received sight, until they called the parents of him having received sight

19.w: and asked them, saying, “Is this your⁺ son, of whom you⁺ say that he was born blind? Then how does he now see?”

20.w: Therefore his parents answered and said, “We know that this is our son and that he was born blind.

21.w: But how he sees now, we do not know; or who opened his eyes, we do not know. Ask him. He has age. He will speak concerning himself.”

22.w: His parents said these things because they were afraid of the Jews. For the Jews already had agreed together that if anyone should confess Him [as] Christ, he would be expelled from the synagogue.

23.w: Because of this, his parents said, “He has age. Ask him.”

24.w: Therefore they called out a second time the man who was blind, and they said to him, “Give glory to God! We know that this man is a sinner.”

25.w: Therefore he answered, “Whether He is a sinner I do not know. One [thing] I know, that being blind, now I see!”

26.w: Therefore they said to him, “What did He do to you? How did He open your eyes?”

27.w: He answered them, “I told you⁺ already, and you⁺ did not hear. Why do you⁺ want to hear again? Do you⁺ also want to become His disciples?”

28.w: And they reviled him and said, “You are a disciple of that One, but we are disciples of Moses.

29.w: We know that God has spoken to Moses, but we do not know from where this [man] is.”

30.w: The man answered and said to them, “In this, indeed, is an amazing thing, that you⁺ do not know from where He is, and [yet] He opened my eyes.

31.w: We know that God does not hear sinners, but if anyone may be God-fearing and may do His will, He hears him.

32.w: From the age it was not heard that anyone opened the eyes of one having been born blind.

33.w: If this [man] were not from God, He would be able to do nothing.”

34.w: They answered and said to him, “You were born entirely in sins, and do you teach us?” And they cast him out.

35.w: Jesus heard that they cast him out, and having found him, He said, “Do you believe in the Son of Man?”

36.w: He answered and said, “And who is He, Lord, that I may believe in Him?”

37.w: Jesus said to him, “You have both seen Him, and He is the One speaking with you.”

38.w: And he was saying, “I believe, Lord.” And he worshiped Him.

39.w: And Jesus said, “For judgment I came into this world, so that those not seeing may see and those seeing may become blind.”

40.w: Some of the Pharisees who were with Him heard these things, and they said to Him, “Are we also blind?”

41.w: Jesus said to them, “If you⁺ were blind, you⁺ would not have sin. But now [that] you⁺ say, ‘We see,’ your⁺ sin remains.[”]
